name: Anne Lockhart
bio: Anne Lockhart (born Anne Kathleen Maloney; September 6, 1953) is an American actress. She is best known for her role as Lieutenant Sheba in the television series Battlestar Galactica (1978–1979). She is the daughter of actress June Lockhart and granddaughter of actor Gene Lockhart.
place: New York City, New York, USA
